pipeline.label: Localization
pipeline.tagline: Knowing where the robot is on the field at all times.
pipeline.description: Autonomous is impossible without knowing the robot's pose — its x, y, and heading on the field. For DECODE we tracked pose with two odometry sources: an optical odometry sensor and a goBILDA Pinpoint odometry computer, integrating their readings into a running position estimate. This pose feeds every downstream decision: which way to turn, how far to drive, and when a routine is complete.
points: Optical odometry paired with a goBILDA Pinpoint computer (DECODE)
IMU/heading fusion keeps orientation accurate over long routines
Pose estimate updated every control loop
Coordinate frame anchored to a known starting position

pipeline.label: Path Planning
pipeline.tagline: Laying out the waypoints and actions before the match.
pipeline.description: Each autonomous routine is a planned sequence of waypoints and mechanism actions. We design paths to be efficient and collision-free, sequencing scoring actions between drive segments. Paths are built and tuned on the practice field, then saved so the same routine runs identically at competition.
points: Routines defined as ordered waypoints plus actions
Paths designed to avoid partners and field obstacles
Scoring actions interleaved with drive segments
Multiple routines prepared for different alliance scenarios

pipeline.label: Path Following
pipeline.tagline: Driving the planned path smoothly and accurately.
pipeline.description: We follow paths with Pedro Pathing — a reactive follower built around Bézier-curve paths instead of stop-and-turn segments. Every loop it reads the live pose and computes a correction vector that pulls the robot back onto the curve, keeping motion smooth and fully closed-loop on position and heading. A nudge from a partner or a bit of wheel slip gets corrected instead of derailing the routine.
points: Pedro Pathing follower tracks smooth Bézier-curve paths
Vector-based correction pulls the robot back onto the path every loop
Closed-loop on position and heading — recovers from bumps and slip
Constants tuned live and replayed identically at competition

pipeline.label: Vision Correction
pipeline.tagline: Snapping the pose estimate back to ground truth.
pipeline.description: Odometry drifts over time as small errors accumulate. AprilTag vision fixes this: when the camera sees a field tag, we compute the robot's true position and snap the odometry estimate back to reality. This keeps precision high across a full 30-second routine and enables reliable alignment to scoring targets.
points: AprilTag detection resets accumulated odometry drift
Robot pose recovered from known tag positions
Accuracy maintained across the full routine
